integrity: The theorem uses a complete symbolic proof; finite independent spanning-tree enumeration and Walsh transform checks corroborate 106 instances. Closely related previously published subfamilies and tree counts are credited.
scientific_limitations: Only simple generalized theta graphs with at least three paths of length at least two; full rank via exact finite binomial sum rather than uniform closed formula; no independent audit or exhaustive priority proof. The first-public date identifies an archival motivating source, not publication of this new theorem.
title: Parity classification and sharp Fourier gaps for spanning trees of generalized theta graphs
